reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend and dayFromDate, but the daily-skip-versus-move weekend dispatch is rebuilt inline rather than extracted from getUpcomingDates into something both share.

duplication.why: The skipsWeekends computation and the skip/move branching are a near copy of getUpcomingDates (and of the same rule in getNextDate), so the weekend rule now lives in a third place.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered alongside it, matching where the tree puts schedule handlers.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, but a future change to the weekend rule has to be repeated in getUpcomingDates, getNextDate and this handler.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing per-occurrence weekend-adjust abstraction to go around; it calls the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in schedules/app.ts reshapes getUpcomingDates' skipsWeekends/isWeekend/getDateWithSkippedWeekend dispatch into nested ifs with continue instead of sharing it.
